_about: check:no-active-org-in-reads baseline (lane ORG-FILTER-CLASS, 2026-09-30). Shrink-only, ONE ROW PER CALL SITE (key = file::enclosing function::call expression#n; no line numbers): fix the site (or annotate a write/server-call read with // org-filter: <class> <reason>) and delete its row. A new read in an already-listed file has no row and fails. Classes from the census: silent-filter and labelled-active-default are defects under policies/access-ladder.md rule 1; write-target / default-for-new / not-a-list / admin-platform need only the line annotation (or the heuristic tightened).
